The '''Jindo''' is a [[sept]] of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]]. The sept hold is unknown. The sept chief is [[Heirn]].

==Activities==
When word reaches the Jindo that the [[Shaido]] are making their way to [[Chaendaer]], Heirn takes the Jindo there to "protect" [[Rhuarc]].{{ref/book|4|23}} When [[Rand al'Thor]] comes back from [[Rhuidean]], Rhuarc has the Jindo guard him.{{ref/book|4|35}} The Jindo also protect and follow Rand on their way to [[Cold Rocks Hold]]{{ref/book|4|36}}, [[Imre Stand]]{{ref/book|4|37}}, and [[Alcair Dal]]. On their way to Alcair Dal, [[Rand al'Thor]] and the Jindo are joined by other Taardad septs including the [[Nine Valleys]], [[Chumai]], [[Four Stones]], [[Bloody Water]] and [[Miadi]] septs.{{ref/book|4|57}}
